# controld_custom_rule (Resource)

Manages a single custom rule within a ControlD profile: a hostname-based DNS action (block, bypass, spoof, or redirect).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "controld_custom_rule" "block_ads" {
  profile_id = controld_profile.home.id
  hostname   = "ads.example.com"
  do         = 0 # block
  status     = true
  group      = controld_rule_folder.ads.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `do` (Number) The action to take: `0` (block), `1` (bypass), `2` (spoof), or `3` (redirect).
- `hostname` (String) The hostname this rule applies to. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `profile_id` (String) The identifier of the profile this rule belongs to.
- `status` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled.

### Optional

- `group` (Number) The identifier of the rule folder (`controld_rule_folder`) this rule belongs to. `0` means no folder.
- `via` (String) The destination IP/hostname used when `do` is `spoof` or `redirect`.
- `via_v6` (String) The IPv6 destination used when `do` is `spoof` or `redirect`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this resource, equal to `hostname`.
- `order` (Number) The position of the rule within its folder.
